parameters.query: =SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Description, Status, Priority, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate FROM Case WHERE Customer_Id__c = '{{ String($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.customer_id).replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}'

=SELECT t.external_id, t.order_id, t.last_status, date_format(t.updated_at, 'dd MMM') AS updated
FROM workspace.agentic_support.request_tracker t
WHERE t.customer_id = :customer_id AND t.kind = 'ticket'
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
